integrity: The proof is an unrestricted finite combinatorial and homotopy argument. Code enumerates bounded examples only; external independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard dihedral graph action is covered.
Only individual subgroup fixed-space homotopy types and PL models, not the full fixed-point restriction diagram.
Cyclic-subgroup homotopy multiplicities and Smith comparison use the published nonequivariant theorem.
Unindexed equivalent literature remains an originality risk.
title: Dihedral-subgroup fixed-point topology of Möbius-ladder independence complexes
